title: Obsidian Pillars
description: A cluster of jet-black obsidian pillars juts from the cracked earth like the teeth of some buried leviathan. Their surfaces are razor-sharp and reflect the orange sky in dark, warped streaks. Between them, narrow gaps hold pockets of volcanic glass and wind-blown debris.

choices.label: Break off shards
choices.description: Carefully fracture pieces from the obsidian pillars.

outcomes.text: Clean strikes split the obsidian into razor-edged shards perfect for crafting. You wrap them carefully.
The pillar fractures unevenly, yielding only a single usable shard. The rest crumbles to dust.
The pillar explodes into fragments! Razor-sharp obsidian shrapnel peppers your party. You salvage what you can through bleeding fingers.

choices.label: Harvest the glass deposits
choices.description: Collect the volcanic glass wedged between the pillars.

outcomes.text: Intact sheets of volcanic glass sit sheltered between the pillars, protected from wind and ash. An excellent find.
Some glass has cracked from thermal stress, but enough remains intact to be worth collecting.
You squeeze between the pillars and get cut by the razor edges. Blood trickles as you grab what glass you can.

choices.label: Search between the pillars
choices.description: Rummage through the debris caught in the narrow gaps.

outcomes.text: Wind-blown coins, a lost traveler's purse, and bits of ember dust have accumulated in the gaps. A lucky find.
A few coins and scraps of charred cloth. Not much, but it didn't cost anything either.
Your arm wedges tight between pillars as you reach for something glinting. It takes painful effort to wrench free.
